notes: ACCESS: direct HTTP fetch (curl, no browser needed) worked throughout, tier 1 sufficient for the whole company - IKEA's category pages are SSR HTML with a plp-filter-information__total-count span carrying the exact item count. ROBOTS: fetched https://www.ikea.com/robots.txt (single host, HTTP 200, 4054 bytes, same file already vetted for SR 107/140/164/184 - IKEA robots.txt is not per-market-path). Groups present: AdsBot-Google(-Mobile) Allow-only, AmazonProductDiscoverybot Disallow: /, and User-agent: *. No Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User named anywhere (case-insensitive check) so no hard stop; we fall under '*'. None of the '*' disallow patterns (search/, compare*, ?filter=, ?sorting=, storeId=, catalogId=, productId=, /iows/, /navigation/, fragments, /rl/, /cdn-cgi/ etc.) were touched - every URL fetched was a plain /in/en/cat/<slug>-<id>/ listing page, no query strings, no API host. TREE SOURCE: IKEA's own server-rendered in-page nav carousel (a.hnf-inpage-nav__card), entry point https://www.ikea.com/in/en/cat/bathroom-products-ba001/ (department id ba001, same id used by SR107 DE/SR140 FR/SR164 UAE/SR184 JP; India's own slug is 'bathroom-products-ba001', NOT 'bathroom-ba001' - the JP-pattern URL 301-redirects to this canonical India slug, confirming IKEA India has its own catalog naming, not a copy of another market). LEAF RULE (same as prior IKEA markets, re-verified live here): a node WITH children shows a first back-link card to its parent then its real children; a node with NO children shows the full top-level sibling list instead - used to positively confirm every recorded node is a genuine leaf (bathroom-shelves-20615, bathroom-countertops-30565, bathroom-sinks-20723, bathroom-taps-20724 all showed the sibling pattern). QTY: every recorded qty is the exact 'N items' string from plp-filter-information__total-count on that node's own page, cross-checked against the page's own <h1> and rel=canonical to rule out the bad-slug-serves-wrong-number trap - all matched. Root ba001 renders NO total-count span of its own (pure grouping node, consistent with the same finding on SR184 JP). DEDUP: checked every candidate leaf/id against pipeline/bathroom_json_archive/cross_category_url_index.json both by exact URL and by trailing numeric/alpha id (IKEA slug-rename trap) before recording. Excluded whole subtrees, all confirmed already-extracted: Bathroom vanities (20719) and its 3 children vanity-units-20720/vanity-units-without-basin-54989/under-sink-cabinets-20721 -> Furniture.xlsx; Bathroom Storage (shelf-units-20804) -> Furniture.xlsx+Storage.xlsx; Bathroom wall cabinets (20808) -> Furniture.xlsx; Bathroom organisers (16233) -> Storage.xlsx; Bathroom trolleys (20858) -> Furniture.xlsx+Storage.xlsx; Bathroom stools & benches (20859) -> Furniture.xlsx; Bathroom mirrors (20490) and its 3 children vanity-mirrors-20498/makeup-mirrors-magnifying-mirrors-20499/mirrors-with-lights-49138 -> Wall_Decor.xlsx; Bathroom lighting (10736) -> Lighting.xlsx; within Bathroom laundry (ba003): laundry-baskets-20601 -> Storage.xlsx and laundry-cabinets-shelving-48925 -> Furniture.xlsx+Storage.xlsx; within Bath towels and mats (tl003): bath-mats-20519 -> Textile.xlsx and shower-curtains-18908 -> Textile.xlsx (the latter also reachable from the Showers node - same URL, one record, dropped from Showers per rule 28). ROUTING (classification exclusions, not dedup - none of these are indexed elsewhere, they were tested against bathroom.md's own scope list and found out of scope): Bathroom laundry's Laundry accessories(55004)/Drying racks(20602)/Ironing boards(20608) are general household laundry equipment, not a Bathroom fixture/accessory/storage/ceramic/sanitaryware per rule 3, and not bathroom-specific by function (no-crossover rule 30-33) - left unclassified here for Storage/Furniture's own runs to consider, not recorded as Bathroom. Bath towels and mats (tl003) is hierarchically parented under Home textiles (tl001), not ba001, despite appearing as a cross-linked sibling on the ba001 page; its children Towels(20520) and Spa accessories(700339) were opened and both are Textile/apparel (towels; bathrobes, slippers, scrub mitts, toiletry bags) per rule 20 - entire subtree is Textile scope, none recorded here. Bathroom furniture systems (700450, parent, 118 items) and its 5 named collections (AENGSJOEN 700453=72, TAENNFORSEN 700456=74, ENHET 700458=67, NYSJOEN 700459=8, VIDVESSEL 700868=9) are NOT present in the dedup index under any URL or numeric id, so per rule 9 ('Furniture Sets... include when the site presents it as Bathroom') they are recorded as genuine Bathroom rows - this is a real difference from IKEA JP (SR184), whose bathroom nav did not surface an equivalent node. DUPLICATE LINK: shower-accessories-10658 (25 items) is reachable from both the Bathroom accessories parent and the Showers parent; recorded once, under Bathroom accessories, per rule 28. RESULT: 4 grouping rows (root Bathroom, Bathroom furniture systems, Bathroom accessories, Showers) + 13 genuine leaves.
